svg.title: IL-12 / interferon-gamma axis
svg.desc: A macrophage holding mycobacteria (red rods) releases IL-12 (amber circles), which acts on a T cell or NK cell; that cell answers with interferon gamma (blue diamonds), which activates the macrophage to kill. Each cell carries the receptor for the other signal. Defects cause Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease.
